workingTreeNote: Evidence was produced with the checkpoint changes in the working tree; unrelated pre-existing changes were preserved.
classification: STAGED / LIFECYCLE CONTRACT PROVEN / PRODUCTION DEFAULT HOLD

authority.coordinateGate: Frontier runs only when storedPositionCount is zero and the graph is non-empty.
authority.frontier: Worker-side Frontier-12 candidate generation plus the existing pure Product proposal evaluation/selection.
authority.mainThread: operation identity, generation and snapshot checks; render-only derived-position adoption; fallback and session authority.
authority.dataset: Dataset, stored/authored Coordinates, persistence and dirty-state remain outside the operation.
authority.productPresentation: Routing, Relation-label, Node-label and Self-loop presentation remain Product-owned.

lifecycle.snapshot: immutable cloned WorkerGraph plus explicit config, operationId, generation and semantic Dataset/graph identity
lifecycle.success: complete, finite selected positions matching the current operation are adopted into render-only positions and viewport fit
lifecycle.failure: partial output is not adopted; the already-published settleInitialPlacement result remains the bounded fallback
lifecycle.cancel: termination is performed and the result is not published
lifecycle.stale: dataset replacement, dataset/manual mutation, workspace exit, unmount and operation replacement invalidate delivery authority
lifecycle.lateResult: late messages cannot reach the cleared handler or pass the App generation/identity guard
lifecycle.viewport: viewport state is not included in semantic identity and is not a Dataset mutation

cases: validated current success and complete positions
invalidation termination and late completion rejection
structured Worker failure with bounded fallback

observed.initialPlacementTiming: current/current-product fallback was published before the async result
